items.title: DILG, DepEd to formalize ‘visible patrols’ in public schools
items.description: These "visible patrols," according to Castro, may be composed of barangay security officers, particularly women, to monitor situations inside the schools.

items.title: Congressman Gato of Batanes dies, 66
items.description: The incumbent congressman from the lone district of Batanes died on Monday due to cardiac arrest. He was 66.

items.title: Metro Manila rainwater impounding facilities to cost P4 billion
items.description: The five proposed rainwater impounding facilities in Metro Manila can store up to 107,600 cubic meters of rainwater and would require more than P4 billion in funding, according to Executive Secretary Ralph Recto.

items.title: Philippines developing options on vessel ramming by China
items.description: The Philippines is “developing options” to address the ramming of a Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources vessel by a China Coast Guard ship last Friday off Palawan, Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro said.

items.title: House OKs P785.2 million OVP budget for 2027
items.description: The proposed P785.2-million 2027 budget of the Office of Vice President – which is 11.7 percent lower than this year’s P889.2 million allotment – breezed through House plenary deliberations without any interpellations yesterday.

items.title: P27.4 billion extra MAIFIP fund to benefit 5 million families
items.description: An estimated five million families will benefit from the additional P27.41-billion funding allocated for the Medical Assistance to Indigent and Financially Incapacitated Patients or MAIFIP program, according to the Department of Health.

items.title: Government OKs P2.48 billion project to upgrade national ID system
items.description: The government has approved a P2.48-billion public-private partnership project to further develop and enhance the national identification system, the Philippine Statistics Authority said yesterday.

items.title: 33% expect economy to improve in a year – SWS
items.description: Three in every 10 Filipinos expect the Philippine economy to improve in the next 12 months, according to a new survey by Social Weather Stations.

items.title: Philippines-EU free trade agreement seen next year
items.description: The Philippines and the European Union are expected to sign a free trade agreement next year after the conclusion of negotiations.

items.title: Cyber patrols to be intensified vs online ‘grooming’
items.description: Cyber patrols will be enhanced to detect online “grooming,” recruitment and other activities exposing minors to violence or criminal behavior, according to the National Capital Region Police Office.
